text:
Asha: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands reliability segment. RCA is up: https://redwood.example/rca/INC-2026-043. Please skim the summary and grab any outstanding action items.

Ravi: Thanks — looks like the main gap is missing circuit-breaker coverage for the routing layer. Who owns adding that in the runtime?

Leah: @Ravi and I discussed a lightweight CB already. I can draft the design doc for the runtime change, but need an owner for the rollout plan.

Ravi: I can own the rollout plan (staging -> canary -> global). Will create a ticket and add milestones.

Marta: Can someone clip the all-hands segment about the rollback decision? Product needs context.

Alex: I'll clip it and post the link here when done. ETA ~45m.

oncall-bot: Incident bot: INC-2026-043 transitioned to "postmortem" by Asha.

Leah: For telemetry: we need a dashboard that surfaces CB open rate, fallback count, per-model latency P99. @Alex can you pair with Observability on queries?

Alex: Yep, will open an obs ticket and tag dashboards-team.

Asha: Dedicated customers: Sales wants a short FAQ about what happened and mitigations. @Ravi can you draft a 2-paragraph note and send to #customer-success for review?

Ravi: On it. Targeting to post by EOD tomorrow.

Leah: For the runbook update, add a “when to pause canary” checklist and explicit metric thresholds. I'll add acceptance criteria.

Marta: Clip posted: https://redwood.example/clips/1782103001-rollback-segment.mp4

Alex: Observability ticket: OBS-789 opened with initial queries.

Ravi: Created rollout ticket: INC-2026-043#rollout and assigned milestones.

Asha: Thanks all. Final ask — please add owners inline in the RCA doc (use the inline table at the top) so we have a single source of truth. Ping here when you add yourself. :white_check_mark:
